salt_pct.quote: highest levels of salt were found in Gubbeen and Tilsit (Fig.3) at 2.0 and 1.8 g/100 g, respectively; the other three cheeses all contained around 1.5 g/100 g

ph.quote: surface pHs ranged from 5.9 for Gubbeen cheese to 6.8 for Ardrahan cheese

ammonia.reason: NH3 from oxidative deamination of amino acids by Brevibacterium linens / smear flora raising surface pH to ~5.9

animal_barnyard.reason: p-cresol, phenol and indole from Tyr/Trp catabolism by smear coryneforms and Microbacterium gubbeenense

bitter.reason: low accumulation of hydrophobic rennet-derived peptides due to short 4-5 week ripening and yeast debittering

blue_moldy.reason: no Penicillium roqueforti and negligible methyl ketones 2-heptanone/2-nonanone in washed-rind make

browning.reason: Maillard between free amino acids from smear proteolysis and residual galactose on heating, typical washed-rind

buttery.reason: diacetyl/acetoin from citrate metabolism by mesophilic Lactococcus lactis starter

cheesy_sweaty.reason: butanoic, hexanoic and 3-methylbutanoic acids from lipolysis and Leu catabolism by smear bacteria

creaminess.reason: 43% moisture with ~30% fat plus rennet/plasmin proteolysis softening casein matrix

crumbliness.reason: elastic rennet gel with washed low-acid curd, not acid-precipitated or long-aged

firmness.reason: semi-soft uncooked rennet curd at 43% moisture, firmer than bloomy but far from hard cheese

floral_honey.reason: 2-phenylethanol and phenylacetaldehyde from phenylalanine catabolism by yeasts/smear flora

fruity.reason: ethyl butanoate/hexanoate from esterification of fatty acids with ethanol by Debaryomyces / Geotrichum yeasts

goaty.reason: cow milk lacks high 4-methyloctanoic/4-ethyloctanoic goat acids, no caprine character

malty_nutty.reason: 3-methylbutanal/2-methylbutanal from Leu/Ile Strecker degradation, described nutty note

melt.reason: rennet-coagulated pH ~5.9 calcium-paracasein network flows on heating, not acid/heat-set

mushroom_earthy.reason: 1-octen-3-ol from linoleic acid oxidation via yeast/Geotrichum lipoxygenase on rind

oil_off.reason: limited free oil from moderate lipolysis of milkfat at ~52% fat-in-dry-matter

smoky.reason: no smoking step and no guaiacol/phenol deposition in typical Gubbeen

sour_vinegar.reason: residual lactic plus acetic acid from starter, partly deacidified by surface yeasts to pH 5.9

stretch.reason: no pasta-filata hot-water stretching, rennet curd does not align into fibers

sulfur_cooked.reason: methanethiol/dimethyl disulfide from methionine demethiolation by B. linens and M. gubbeenense

sweet.reason: lactose depleted but sweet amino acids and glycerol from lipolysis remain

umami.reason: glutamate release from rennet and starter proteolysis during 4-5 week smear ripening
